title: Hub stream frame
description: Hub to shell or phone (C-07.18 to C-07.23). A live subscription gets hello then events frames and pings; a JSON read (10's ReadActivity, POST /hub/api/read) gets one events frame. The gap fields copy web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/core/bus.js read() (lines 208-218).

hello.description: The snapshot a subscription starts from (C-07.20).

stream.description: The hub stream: chat:<chat_id>, machine:<machine_id>, or hub (C-07.1, section 2).

cursor.description: The last seq the snapshot includes; the next events frame starts at cursor.seq + 1.

state.description: The stream's current state record (contract 05 shapes: a chat's state dot, queue counts, unseen Activity; a machine's liveness and versions).

at.description: Hub clock when the snapshot was taken.

events.description: Events after a cursor, with bus.read's gap semantics (C-07.19).

stream.description: The hub stream: chat:<chat_id>, machine:<machine_id>, or hub (C-07.1, section 2).

epoch.description: The stream's epoch: ep_ and a ULID, re-minted only when the stream's numbering is rewritten (C-07.4).

oldest.description: The lowest retained seq, null for an empty stream.

gap.description: True when the reader's cursor cannot be continued: events were pruned past it, or it is from another epoch or ahead of latest.

dropped.description: oldest - 1 - since when pruned; 0 otherwise and with reset.

reset.description: True when the cursor is from another epoch, ahead of latest, or the hub cut a slow subscriber (C-07.23). The reader resubscribes without since.

more.description: JSON read only: more events remain after the last one sent.

ping.description: Keep-alive on a live subscription, every 15 s like the daemon's SSE ping (events.js SSE_HEARTBEAT_MS).
